method: Embedded figure: match orientation of spring
steps: X is a horizontal coil with three loops hanging below a straight line, tails at both ends
A has only two loops; B's coil is vertical (would need rotation)
D has three loops but they rise above the line (flipped)
C has a horizontal line with three loops below it, same orientation as X

method: Symmetry of figure about vertical axis
steps: The figure is mirror-symmetric about the vertical diameter: top-left mirrors top-right

Missing bottom-right quadrant must mirror bottom-left: vertical and horizontal sides of an inner square meeting at a corner near the arc, a diagonal from the centre to that corner, the chord from right end of horizontal diameter to bottom of circle, and the steep line from that corner up to the horizontal diameter (continuation of the line from the top)
Option A has exactly these lines; B, C, D differ (wrong diagonal, wrong steep-line direction, partial vertical)
Six slots: top-right p1, mid-centre p2, mid-right p3, bottom-left p4, bottom-centre p5, bottom-right p6
Fig1->Fig2 and Fig3->Fig4 use the same move: p1->p3, p3->p6, p4->p2, p5->p4, p6->p5, p2 leaves, new symbol at p1
Fig2->Fig3 move: p1->p4, p2->p3, p3->p5, p4->p1, p5->p6, p6->p2; so Fig4->Fig5 uses this

method: Circles move clockwise one corner, alternately
steps: Fig1 circles at top-left and top-right; Fig2 both at top-right; Fig3 top-right and bottom-right; Fig4 both at bottom-right
Circles advance clockwise one corner, one at a time
Fig5: one at bottom-right, the other at bottom-left = option A
check_code:
order=['TL','TR','BR','BL']
seq=[('TL','TR'),('TR','TR'),('TR','BR'),('BR','BR')]
# lagging circle catches up, then the leading circle moves ahead
a,b=seq[-1]
nxt=tuple(sorted((b, order[(order.index(b)+1)%4])))
opts={'A':('BL','BR'),'B':('BL','BOTTOM_MID'),'C':('BL','BL_OUT'),'D':('BR','TR')}
assert [k for k,v in opts.items() if tuple(sorted(v))==nxt]==['A']
